# Event

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

One keyboard, mouse, queue-overflow, audio-channel or logical-resize event returned by `Terminal.Input`. For `EventKind.Resize`, only `Kind` and `Time` are meaningful; read a fresh `Terminal.Info` for dimensions.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#input-and-events).

## Action

`Event.Action: MouseAction`

Read-only instance property.

Mouse action, changed button, or wheel delta for `EventKind.Mouse`; other kinds return neutral values.

## Alt

`Event.Alt: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether the corresponding modifier was active for `EventKind.Key` or `EventKind.Mouse`; other kinds return `FALSE`.

## Button

`Event.Button: MouseButton`

Read-only instance property.

Mouse action, changed button, or wheel delta for `EventKind.Mouse`; other kinds return neutral values.

## Channel

`Event.Channel: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Audio channel reported as drained by an `EventKind.Audio` event.

## Code

`Event.Code: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Translated key code or text for `EventKind.Key`; other kinds return zero or an empty string.

## Ctrl

`Event.Ctrl: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether the corresponding modifier was active for `EventKind.Key` or `EventKind.Mouse`; other kinds return `FALSE`.

## Dropped

`Event.Dropped: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Number of queue entries lost before an `EventKind.Overflow` event.

## Kind

`Event.Kind: EventKind`

Read-only instance property.

Discriminator for this event. Read only the properties meaningful for the selected `EventKind`.

## LeftDown

`Event.LeftDown: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether the corresponding mouse button was held for `EventKind.Mouse`; other kinds return `FALSE`.

## Pixels

`Event.Pixels: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

## Pressed

`Event.Pressed: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

## Repeated

`Event.Repeated: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Repeat flag for `EventKind.KeyEdge`; other kinds return `FALSE`.

## RightDown

`Event.RightDown: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

## ScanCode

`Event.Shift: BOOLEAN`
